blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Oil prices will move in mixed directions on Tuesday, with gasoline increasing by P1.56 per liter and kerosene by P1.77 per liter, while diesel prices will drop by P3.01 per liter, according to the Department of Energy (DOE). The latest adjustments come amid continued concerns over possible oil supply disruptions due to the conflict in the Middle East.
